explanation: Subtracting twice the second equation from the first gives x₂=-x₃+3x₄. Substitution gives x₁=-4x₃+7x₄. Thus every null vector is x₃(-4,-1,1,0)+x₄(7,3,0,1). These two vectors are linearly independent because their third and fourth coordinates are (1,0) and (0,1), so option b is a basis.
